assets.public/icon.png:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: production app icon for Firstlight UI, a native iOS and Android component showcase.
Primary request: Create a single exceptional, distinctive, beautifully precise app icon: a sculptural rising sun made from three nested architectural arches, cut by one clean horizontal horizon, subtly suggesting an F and layered interface components. A compact memorable silhouette, soft machined edges, sophisticated restraint.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed solid very deep ink slate #0F172A square. No exterior rounded corners, the OS applies its own icon mask.
Subject: one centered luminous sunrise emblem, broad rounded arch geometry, warm ember red #AE1515 transitioning into orange #ED4E0C and a small warm pale apricot highlight on the upper edge. Crisp silhouette and restrained dimensional shading inside the mark. The emblem occupies roughly 58% of the square width with generous breathing room.
Style/medium: premium contemporary software brand identity, vector-like precision with subtle physical depth, editorial, confident, minimal.
Composition/framing: exactly square 1024 by 1024, dead-center mark, flat frontal view, no perspective, every corner fully opaque ink. 
Text: none.
Constraints: deliver only the finished icon artwork, no mockup, no presentation board, no surrounding frame, no letters, no watermark, no scattered sparkles or extra symbols. Recognizable at 32px.
assets.public/splash.png:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: production portrait launch splash screen for Firstlight UI showcase app.
Input image: reference identity. Reuse the precise orange/red sunrise emblem from the supplied app icon, preserving its two nested arch bands, central semicircle, and three horizontal rounded bars below the horizon. Remove the icon's square backdrop; integrate the emblem directly into the splash.
Primary request: an exquisitely minimal polished splash screen, exactly 1280 pixels wide by 2560 pixels tall, portrait 1:2 ratio. Solid #F8FAFC, very pale cool white edge to edge. A small, perfectly crisp sunrise emblem only 280px wide, horizontally centered with emblem center at y=1150px. Under the emblem, generous 70px gap then the exact wordmark "Firstlight UI" centered in refined medium-weight contemporary sans-serif type, 64px font size, #0F172A deep ink. Under the wordmark, a 30px gap and "SHOWCASE" in widely tracked 22px uppercase, #64748B muted slate. Keep the whole mark-and-type group balanced around the center of the screen. Lots of clean negative space.
Style/medium: restrained premium native software identity, crisp vector-like finish, subtle dimensional shading only inside emblem.
Constraints: preserve emblem identity exactly. Flat solid background including all corners. No icon tile behind the mark, no device frame, no UI elements, no status bar, no loading indicator, no footer, no gradients in background, no decorative sun rays, no shadows or glows outside the mark, no watermark. Only text is verbatim "Firstlight UI" and "SHOWCASE".
assets.public/splash-dark.png:
Use case: lighting-weather
Asset type: dark appearance variant of the supplied Firstlight UI splash screen.
Input image: edit target, final LIGHT splash screen.
Primary request: Change ONLY the background and the two text colors. Replace all near-white background pixels, including the empty gaps within the sunrise, with solid #0F172A deep ink slate. Recolor the existing "Firstlight UI" wordmark to #F8FAFC near-white. Recolor existing "SHOWCASE" to #94A3B8.
Invariants: retain EXACTLY the input image dimensions 1280 by 2560, same logo shape, same logo position and size, same warm colors and shading of logo, same precise wordmark font weight and glyph shapes, same "SHOWCASE" tracking, same text baselines, same everything else. Do not redraw, rearrange, resize or restyle any element. Background must be uniform flat #0F172A to all four edges with no texture, vignette, gradient, glow or external shadows. Deliver a finished opaque portrait splash screen only.
